context: Agent liveness timestamps churn on every call (pure git noise) and embeddings are a rebuildable local index; a team may gitignore records/ entirely.
rationale: Deletion propagation keyed on per-kind directory existence means an absent tree is read as 'not synced', never as 'everything was deleted' — the failure mode that would wipe a database on first ingest.
summary: Export tree excludes agents and embeddings, and ingest never deletes without the corresponding kind directory present
